claim.label: economics
claim.sentence: Assembly economics The honest unit of account here is engineering hours per part number, not robots per line; a vendor whose deployment cost does not fall with the tenth customer does not have a product yet.

value.text: The honest unit of account here is engineering hours per part number, not robots per line; a vendor whose deployment cost does not fall with the tenth customer does not have a product yet.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Assembly vendors are routinely valued on installed cells, which flatters a business whose margin is consumed by per-customer integration. The metric that predicts whether the category compounds is the trend in engineering hours per deployment.
advance_criteria: Would firm up with vendors disclosing deployment engineering hours over time.
